note: Set A is better because it captures critical dimensional data (elevations for grade, finished floor, and solar envelope) which Set B omits entirely. Set A is also more concise, whereas Set B contains significant redundancy (e.g., extracting the handrail and cladding specs three and two times respectively). Set A has one likely error interpreting the 18' solar envelope height as measured from the finished floor rather than grade level, but its overall coverage and lack of trivial duplicates make it superior.
